cases.algorithm: R1.latest_valid; remembered-chain ruleOFF by exact source/build lineage

native_stage_controls.query: FROM sequence-golden-g41 METADATA _id | WHERE stage_1_rows IS NOT NULL | MV_EXPAND stage_1_rows | DISSECT stage_1_rows "%{row_rank_text}|%{row_key}|%{label}|%{encoded_values}" | EVAL row_rank=TO_INTEGER(row_rank_text), value=TO_INTEGER(SPLIT(NULLIF(encoded_values,"~"),",")) | KEEP _id,event_ordinal,key,row_rank,label,value | SORT event_ordinal,key,row_rank | LIMIT 1000

FROM sequence-golden-g41 METADATA _id | WHERE stage_2_rows IS NOT NULL | MV_EXPAND stage_2_rows | DISSECT stage_2_rows "%{row_rank_text}|%{row_key}|%{label}|%{encoded_values}" | EVAL row_rank=TO_INTEGER(row_rank_text), value=TO_INTEGER(SPLIT(NULLIF(encoded_values,"~"),",")) | KEEP _id,event_ordinal,key,row_rank,label,value | SORT event_ordinal,key,row_rank | LIMIT 1000

FROM sequence-golden-g41 METADATA _id | WHERE stage_3_rows IS NOT NULL | MV_EXPAND stage_3_rows | DISSECT stage_3_rows "%{row_rank_text}|%{row_key}|%{label}|%{encoded_values}" | EVAL row_rank=TO_INTEGER(row_rank_text), value=TO_INTEGER(SPLIT(NULLIF(encoded_values,"~"),",")) | KEEP _id,event_ordinal,key,row_rank,label,value | SORT event_ordinal,key,row_rank | LIMIT 1000

cases.query:
SEQUENCE BY key WITHIN 1000000000ms PRIMARY s1
(FROM sequence-golden-g41 METADATA _id | WHERE stage_1_rows IS NOT NULL | MV_EXPAND stage_1_rows | DISSECT stage_1_rows "%{row_rank_text}|%{row_key}|%{label}|%{encoded_values}" | EVAL row_rank=TO_INTEGER(row_rank_text), value=TO_INTEGER(SPLIT(NULLIF(encoded_values,"~"),",")) | KEEP key,label,value,row_rank,_id) AS s1,
(FROM sequence-golden-g41 METADATA _id | WHERE stage_2_rows IS NOT NULL | MV_EXPAND stage_2_rows | DISSECT stage_2_rows "%{row_rank_text}|%{row_key}|%{label}|%{encoded_values}" | EVAL row_rank=TO_INTEGER(row_rank_text), value=TO_INTEGER(SPLIT(NULLIF(encoded_values,"~"),",")) | WHERE (value == MEMBER(s1,value)) | KEEP key,label,value,row_rank,_id) AS s2,
(FROM sequence-golden-g41 METADATA _id | WHERE stage_3_rows IS NOT NULL | MV_EXPAND stage_3_rows | DISSECT stage_3_rows "%{row_rank_text}|%{row_key}|%{label}|%{encoded_values}" | EVAL row_rank=TO_INTEGER(row_rank_text), value=TO_INTEGER(SPLIT(NULLIF(encoded_values,"~"),",")) | KEEP key,label,value,row_rank,_id) AS s3
| EVAL label_1=label, doc_1=_id, rank_1=row_rank, label_2=MEMBER(s2,label), doc_2=MEMBER(s2,_id), rank_2=MEMBER(s2,row_rank), label_3=MEMBER(s3,label), doc_3=MEMBER(s3,_id), rank_3=MEMBER(s3,row_rank)
| KEEP label_1,doc_1,rank_1,label_2,doc_2,rank_2,label_3,doc_3,rank_3 | LIMIT 1000
